ask: Do you still want a single view of what is stored on the phone, with sizes? Which option?

found: Settings shows one line: how many kept passages are ready. The Ready for offline screen shows sizes only for what is still to download. Nothing says how much space is used. Pictures are drawn from the app's words, not screenshots.
changed: Nothing is built. This is only the decision and the mockups.
why: Sizes show how much space is used and whether a trip fits. Removing audio belongs to LAN-18, so I kept the options small.
touches: Option B changes only the Ready for offline screen. Option C adds a new screen and overlaps LAN-18. Neither touches Bible Brain text (LAN-19).

linear.comment: Decision prepared, nothing built. Options: leave as is, show sizes in the Ready for offline card (recommended), or a full storage screen with removal (overlaps LAN-18). Bible Brain text stays with LAN-19. See the draft pull request.
